items.title: NEWS #01 · Meta Andromeda 2.0
items.caption:
NEWS #01 · Meta ka Andromeda 2.0: aapka ad kise dikhega? 📢
Meta ne ad chunne wala system badal diya. 3 badlaav:
1️⃣ Speed: ek server pe har second 100 crore+ ads check, pichhle version se 100x
2️⃣ Har eligible ad ko score, har insaan ke liye sabse fit ad
3️⃣ Meta ke hisaab se 2025 se Facebook conversions +2.4%. Koi nayi setting nahi, apne aap.
Matlab: ek hi ad ke 10 version nahi, alag-alag angle chahiye.
✅ Har creative mein alag baat: problem, review, use, comparison
✅ Har hafte 2-3 naye angle
✅ Targeting itni tight nahi ki system ke haath bandh jaayein

items.title: CASE #05 · Perfect 5-star rating, phir bhi sale kam?
items.caption:
CASE #05 · Perfect 5-star rating, phir bhi sale kam? ⭐
Research: log sabse zyada 4.0–4.7 rating wale product khareedte hain. 5.0 ke paas khareedne ka chance girne lagta hai, kyunki itna perfect fake lagta hai.
Aur 5 reviews wala product = 0 reviews wale se 270% zyada khareedne ka chance.
(Source: Spiegel Research Center, Northwestern University)
✅ 3-star review mat chhupao, achha jawab do
✅ Har product pe pehle 5 reviews laao
✅ Delivery ke 4 din baad WhatsApp pe photo wala review maango
Fake review? Kabhi nahi.
👇 Comment karo REVIEW, review maangne wale WhatsApp messages free DM mein.

items.title: CASE #07 · Influencer ko ₹50,000, aaye 3 order
items.caption:
CASE #07 · Influencer ko ₹50,000 diye, aaye sirf 3 order? 😳
Matlab har order ₹16,667 ka pada. Galti influencer ki nahi, hisaab ki thi.
Maan lo product ₹999, saare kharche ke baad ₹450 bachte hain → ek order pe max ₹450 kharch kar sakte ho.
₹50,000 ÷ ₹450 = ~112 orders chahiye the fee wapas laane ko. Aaye 3.
(Example numbers)
✅ 1 bade creator ko ₹50,000 ki jagah, 10 chhote creators ko ₹5,000
✅ Har creator ko alag discount code ya link, taaki pata chale kaun bechta hai
✅ Jo video chala, creator ki permission lekar apne ad mein chalao
👇 Comment karo COLLAB, influencer calculator + creator brief free DM mein.

items.title: CASE #09 · Double price, phir bhi loss
items.caption:
CASE #09 · ₹300 ka maal, ₹599 mein becha. Double price, phir bhi LOSS? 📉
Maan lo ek order ka poora kharcha: product ₹300 + packing ₹25 + shipping ₹70 + payment fee ₹12 + returns ka hissa ₹40 + ad ₹200 = ₹647.
Price ₹599 → har order pe −₹48. Jitna zyada becho, utna zyada loss.
Sahi price = poora kharcha + profit → ₹647 + ₹150 = ₹797 ≈ ₹799.
(Example numbers, GST se pehle)
✅ Har order ka poora kharcha ek baar likho
✅ Ad ka kharcha per order bhi jodo (sab yahi bhoolte hain)
✅ Price nahi badha sakte? Combo se order value badhao
👇 Comment karo PRICE, pricing calculator free DM mein.

items.title: CASE #10 · 10 mein se 7 cart chhod dete hain
items.caption:
CASE #10 · ₹799 ka product, checkout pe ₹947. 10 mein se 7 log cart chhod ke gayab! 🛒
Duniya bhar mein ~70% carts adhoore rehte hain (Baymard Institute, 50 studies ka average: 70.22%).
Sabse bade kaaran: checkout pe extra charge (40%), delivery date pata nahi (20%), pehle account banao (18%).
Maan lo product ₹799 + shipping ₹99 + COD fee ₹49 = ₹947 sirf checkout pe dikha. Customer wahin ruk gaya.
✅ Poora total product page pe hi dikhao
✅ Pincode daalte hi delivery date dikhao
✅ Sign-up hatao: sirf phone + OTP
👇 Comment karo CART, 3 cart reminder WhatsApp messages (copy-paste + sahi time) free DM mein.

items.title: CASE #12 · Marketplace ya apni website?
items.caption:
CASE #12 · Same ₹1,000 ki sale: marketplace pe ya apni website pe, haath mein zyada kahan bachta hai? ⚖️
Maan lo marketplace: ₹1,000 − commission ₹180 − fee ₹30 − shipping ₹70 − returns ₹50 = ₹670.
Website: ₹1,000 − payment fee ₹20 − shipping ₹70 − returns ₹50 − ad ₹250 = ₹610. Order 1: marketplace jeeta.
Order 2: marketplace phir ₹670. Website pe wahi customer WhatsApp se wapas, koi ad nahi = ₹860.
Marketplace = kiraye ki dukaan. Website = apna ghar.
(Example numbers; asli commission marketplace aur category ke hisaab se alag hota hai)
✅ Har channel ka per-order hisaab alag rakho
✅ Marketplace pe sirf high-margin products
✅ Website customers ko WhatsApp se wapas bulao
👇 Comment karo CHANNEL, channel profit calculator free DM mein.

items.caption:
CASE #14 · Profit ₹1.2 lakh, bank mein sirf ₹8,000? Paisa gaya kahan? 💸
Profit kaagaz pe hota hai, cash bank mein. Dono ek din nahi aate.
Maan lo Rohit ka hisaab: ₹52,000 COD abhi courier ke paas + ₹40,000 ka stock godown mein + ₹20,000 ad bill pehle bhar diye = ₹1,12,000 atka.
₹1,20,000 − ₹1,12,000 = bank mein sirf ₹8,000.
(Example numbers; payout cycle courier ke hisaab se alag hota hai)
✅ Courier se chhota COD payout cycle maango (fee check karo)
✅ Stock chhote batch mein lo, best-seller pehle
✅ Har Monday bank ka cash dekho, sirf profit nahi
👇 Comment karo CASH, weekly cash tracker free DM mein.

items.title: CASE #15 · ROAS 3, phir bhi loss?
items.caption:
CASE #15 · ROAS 3 hai, phir bhi paisa doob raha hai? 📉
Humne har rupaye ka hisaab lagaya.
Ad pe ₹10,000 → sale ₹30,000. ROAS 3, dashboard hara.
Ab ₹30,000 todo: maal ₹12,000 + packing-delivery ₹5,400 + returns-charges ₹3,600 = ₹21,000.
Upar se ad ₹10,000. Total ₹31,000. Haath mein: −₹1,000.
ROAS sirf sale ginta hai, kharcha nahi. Is product ka break-even ROAS = 30,000 ÷ (30,000 − 21,000) = 3.3.
(Example numbers; aapke product ka kharcha alag hoga)
✅ Har product ka poora kharcha likho
✅ Uska break-even ROAS nikaalo
✅ Ad sirf usse upar scale karo
👇 Comment karo ROAS, break-even calculator free DM mein.

Matlab ₹300 dekar ₹3,000 ka customer mila. Sasta sauda.
✅ Pichle saal ke customers ka saal bhar ka bill nikaalo
✅ Ad budget usi hisaab se socho
✅ Dusra order 30 din ke andar laane pe zor do
